title: Multiplicity and concentration of dual solutions for a Helmholtz system
summary: In this paper, we are concerned with the nonlinear Helmholtz system of Hamiltonian type \begin{equation*} \left\{\begin{array}{l} -Δu-k^2 u=P(x)|v|^{p-2}v,\quad \text{in}\ \mathbb{R}^N, \\ -Δv-k^2v=Q(x)|u|^{q-2}u,\quad \text{in}\ \mathbb{R}^N, \end{array} \right. \end{equation*} where $N\geq3$, $P,Q: \mathbb{R}^N\rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ are two positive continuous functions, the exponents $p,q>2$ satisfy $\frac{1}{p}+\frac{1}{q}>\frac{N-2}{N}$.
